ceiling: 13.27M (Rockstar version) beat a 20.4M server #2 running Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in regular Arena Season 5; Rye alone dealt 2.21M (dc:75148).
summary: Rye is the only real damage dealer and everything else keeps her alive and buffed. Three tanks switch on Armor Repair, three healers plus Ion's shields outlast the Bari dive, and Pomegranate's first beam is routed onto Rye through ATK order. Since 2026-09-27 most of the top of at least one server has gone back to it; it loses to Bari–Oven only when Bari and Oven are very high-star.

cookies.why: Crit-rate buff along her march line. Hound's Range synergy lines that march up, so Rye standing in line with Hound receives it; without Hound the buff goes astray.
Healing reduction on the enemy plus lift RES and Rapid Fire synergy for allies. Her heal cut is why heal-stacking stopped winning PvP after 8/27.
Skill AMP beam (빨대) that goes to allies by ATK rank. With ATK% runes on Rye the order is Milk › Rye and Rye takes the opening beam.

The flex slot: a second healer so the team outlives the opening burst after the front-line Herb dies first. Rockstar is now preferred here because its shield lands during Bari's first dive (about a 5 s cycle against Grapevine's 5.5 s).
Tank for Armor Repair (3+ tanks). Its Range synergy is what aligns Macaron's march onto Rye; posters who dropped Hound lost Macaron's buff.
Front-column healer. Milk can't heal herself, and Milk + Herb + Ion is what stops the one-shot. Being at the front, she is usually the first to die.

The only real damage: piercing pistols, 2.2–2.5M per fight in screenshots. Give her a few ATK% lines so she ranks right behind Milk and takes Pomegranate's first beam. 8★ on this screenshot (stated in nv:45718, which reposts it); 5★ is the stated minimum for a Rye carry.
ATK buff that lands on Milk (raising Milk's buff for everyone) plus Volley synergy. A tester who removed her saw the team die more often.
Crit-damage field and Chain synergy. Disputed: several players would rather run a dealer or a second healer here; swap her for Doughnut King if Brightseeker goes in.
Captain (merc squad Lv.4). Main healer and team ATK buff; she has to be ATK #1 so Passion Pay lands on her. Passion Pay's −20% HP is why dive decks go for her.
Tank for Armor Repair. Shields on low-HP allies, then a team shield; the shields aren't cut by the enemy Pinot's healing reduction.

Tank for Armor Repair. Lowers ATK and crit rate of nearby enemies (−50% / −130% at 9★ per a datamine), so the enemy front line and its Milk lose their buffs. Called mandatory insurance: without her, Oven kills in 2 s.

atk_order_note: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate, so Pomegranate's beam lands on Rye. Count pet, perk and captain ATK% when checking, and check in battle. Supports can be levelled down to hold the order.
perks: Captain Milk at merc squad Lv.4: 방어구 수리 특약 (Armor Repair, +10% DR with 3+ tanks) + 열정페이 (Passion Pay). In the mirror match the side with perks set wins. Alternatives: Armor Repair + 의료보험 (Health Insurance); 크런치 모드 (Crunch Mode) aimed at a Rye whose armour is removed so she is the lowest-HP ally.

substitutions: Grapevine → Rockstar (preferred since 2026-09-25): its shield comes out during Bari's first dive. Give it 3–4 Skill Haste lines.
Grapevine + Skating Queen → Brightseeker + Doughnut King only with a 5★+ Brightseeker; that version (arena-rye-seeker) loses to this one at 2M more power.
Grapevine → Espresso if Brightseeker is under 5★ and you have no Rockstar.
Chargemellow → Icy Birdie (DR) against burst-heavy servers, or → King Choco Drop.

Heal-tank variant (꿀빵): Moon Rabbit → Strawberry Crepe, with Ion and Crepe held in the high Lv.80s and Rye and Herb in the mid-90s to keep the ATK order Milk › Skating Queen › Macaron. Its author says his server's #1 and #2 run it.
Seo Sinwoo's low-rarity version: same 12, pets Holy Baby Drop / King Choco Drop / Icy Birdie, perks Crunch Mode + Armor Repair; 15.99M beat 16.8M and 16.65M Bari decks.
rng: Against Bari–Oven the fight is decided in the first few seconds: if Ion's and Rockstar's shields and Doughnut's polymorph land before the three chargers connect, Rye wins the long fight; if not, the team is deleted in about 3.5 s. 'Whoever loses Milk or Bari first loses.'

ceiling: The tool of server #1s. At Bari 10★ the Rye deck 'can't hold at all'; a 1★-Bari version at 6.14M beat older decks at twice its power in launch week.
summary: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance wraps the charge cookies (herself plus one ally, two from 5★) in damage reduction, lift and push immunity and periodic damage, and all three chargers dash at the highest-ATK enemy, usually Milk. The dive does about 2M per charger within 3.5 s at equal power. It lives or dies on Bari's and Oven's stars: strong from 5★, dominant at 8–10★, and beaten by the Rye deck below that when the dive doesn't kill.
